title: Shush, Akre & Korek to Erbil
full_text:
Head to Shush village in the morning.
Homemade breakfast in Shush.
Walk around Akre village and visit the Akre Synagogue.
Hike up Akre mountain to the Citadel (Total time ~2hr back and forth, moderate hike.)
Try the traditional foods and sweets of akre.
Head to Rawanduz and enjoy the natural beauty of the area.
Go up Korek Mountain on a cable car.
Head back to Erbil.
